title: Cylindrical base
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, initiate a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, draw a single loop and within that loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.0369, 0.0369] with a radius of 0.0369 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scaling factor of 0.0738 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are both set to zero, no further transformation is needed. Proceed to extrude the scaled two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will generate a solid cylindrical base. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base will be a length of 0.07375125 units, a width of 0.07375125 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base circle
circle_center = (0.0369, 0.0369)
circle_radius = 0.0369

# Create the circle in the sketch
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
extrude_scale = 0.0738

# Perform the extrusion
r = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth, taper=extrude_scale)

# Display the result

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0369, 0.0369)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0369)  # Draw the circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# Rod with circular cross-section (diameter 0.0738) and a longitudinal flat
# The flat is a 45-degree chord from (R, 0) to (0, R), which keeps the full
# X and Y bounding box while producing the single center line seen in the
# RIGHT view and the flat strip visible in the isometric view.

R = 0.0369          # radius (0.0738 / 2)
L = 0.75            # length along Z

m = -R / math.sqrt(2)   # midpoint of the 270-degree arc (at 225 degrees)

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(R, 0)
    .threePointArc((m, m), (0, R))   # major arc leaving the chord for the flat
    .close()                          # straight chord forms the flat face
    .extrude(L)
)
